map.(原值 − 残值) / 年限 使用指南: (Original Cost − Residual Value) / Years User Guide
map.输入资产原值、预计残值与使用年限，按直线法计算每年折旧额与折旧率，适用于固定资产: Enter the asset's original cost, expected residual value and service life to compute annual depreciation and the depreciation rate under the straight-line method, for fixed asset amortization, tax depreciation and book value management.
map.房屋、家具等效用在各期均衡的资产，用直线法平稳分摊成本。: Houses, furniture and other assets whose benefit is evenly spread over the periods are costed smoothly with the straight-line method.
map.需要简单、可预期的年度折旧费用便于预算与报价。: You need simple, predictable annual depreciation costs for budgeting and quotation.
map.税务折旧与会计折旧一致时，减少纳税调整工作量。: When tax and accounting depreciation agree, the tax adjustment workload shrinks.
map.：某设备原值 50 万元、预计残值 5 万元、使用年限 5 年，年折旧=(50−: : an asset with original cost 500000, expected residual value 50000 and 5-year life has annual depreciation = (50−5)/5 = 90000 CNY, monthly depreciation 7500 CNY, and the book value after five years equals the residual value of 50000.
map.由营收、营业成本与费用求 EBIT: EBIT from revenue, operating cost and expenses
map.由经营现金流与资本支出求自由现金流: Free cash flow from operating cash flow and capital expenditure
map.直线法为什么最常用？: Why is the straight-line method the most common?
map.计算简单、各期费用均衡、利润平滑，适合效用稳定、技术更新慢的资产，也便于与外部报: It is simple to calculate, gives even charges across periods and smooths profit, suiting assets with stable utility and slow technology turnover, and easing alignment with external statements and tax.
map.预计净残值为 0 或负数怎么办？: What if the expected net residual value is 0 or negative?
map.净残值一般取预计处置收入减处置费用后的净额，通常≥0；若预计处置费用高于收入，实: Net residual value is generally the net proceeds after expected disposal costs and is usually ≥0; if disposal costs are expected to exceed proceeds, practice still treats it as 0 and it must not go negative.
